aggregateSchemas.scope: 2024 Second Amendment / Forms 8, 10, 11 and 18 field intelligence
Contains schemas for Form 1 (DHA-1756), Form 2 (DHA-1714A), Form 3 (DHA-26) and Form 4 (DHA-TC-01)

notes: DHA_Forms/DHA-1740 is not an authoritative DHA-1740 schema; its current content is an aggregate for Forms 1–4 and should not be treated as Form 9/DHA-1740.
The individual constructed schemas are semantic field specifications. They are not authorised for PDF generation until the exact source PDF and coordinate map are verified.
The canonical DHA-84 coordinate map remains under app/knowledgebase to avoid two independent coordinate-map sources drifting apart.
